text:
Sam Patel: Morning team — quick async standup for LoomCare. What I did / blockers / today:
• Did initial product pitch yesterday; they like the runtime and cost profiles.
• Blocker: they require customer-managed keys (HSM) and on-prem deployment options + data residency assurances. They want a pilot in ~2 weeks.
• Today: need engineering & security confirmation on feasibility + a short checklist to share with them. Pinged folks: @Maya, @Ravi, @Anya, @Leo.

Maya Chen: Got it. I can pull together our Private deployment checklist and a one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private for LoomCare. Quick path: Dedicated + customer-managed cloud KMS is usually fastest for pilots.

Ravi Kapoor: Security notes — we need to confirm whether LoomCare expects a FIPS-validated HSM or just customer-managed keys (CMEK) in cloud. Also need clarity on attestations they require (eg. HSM certs, key rotation policy, access logs). If they want on-prem physical HSM, that adds an audit and support commitment.

Anya Ivanova: Engineering perspective — our Private build supports KMIP-compatible HSMs (vendor-tested list: Thales, Utimaco, AWS CloudHSM via dedicated peering). Integration validation for a new vendor is ~3-4 weeks. Performance caveat: networked HSM calls can add ~15-30ms to key unwrap ops; we mitigate via local key-wrapping cache.
I can draft a small config snippet for a Dedicated pilot that uses customer cloud KMS — will open a PR.

Maya Chen: For the customer-facing doc, I'll include a short matrix: Dedicated (fast pilot, cloud KMS/CMEK) vs Private on-prem (longer lead, HSM onsite). I'll also note typical timelines and support needs.

Leo Burns: Legal — I can draft a narrow addendum for HSM/data residency obligations. Need to confirm: will customer manage the key lifecycle (yes/no)? Also need to know if keys ever transit our control plane (we prefer not).

Sam Patel: LoomCare's initial ask: customer-managed keys, prefer onprem but will consider cloud KMS for pilot. They care about who rotates keys and whether we have proof of HSM attestation. Pilot target is two weeks — is that realistic?

Ravi Kapoor: Two-week pilot feasible only if we do Dedicated + customer cloud KMS (no physical HSM). For onprem HSM pilot, not realistic in 2 weeks because of certs, network setup, and audit scoping.

Anya Ivanova: Agree with Ravi. If Maya confirms Dedicated pilot route, I can prioritize the KMS wiring task. ETA: config + smoke test in 3-5 business days. I'll tag PR reviewers: @devops.

Maya Chen: I'll propose Dedicated pilot as an option in the offer and DM pricing bands. Also will attach our Private checklist and the KMS vendor compatibility table.

Sam Patel: Great — I'll present Dedicated + cloud KMS as the pilot plan. I'll ask LoomCare whether that'll satisfy them for the initial run and get back with their preference. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR opened — infra/loomcare-pilot-config #1234 

Anya Ivanova: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1234 — config + docs scaffold. Please review when you get a moment.

Leo Burns: I'll start the addendum draft and flag it for Sam's review once I confirm key ownership details.

Sam Patel: Closing loop — will update here after LoomCare responds. If anyone has short bullets I can drop into the email to LoomCare, paste them here and I'll include.
